usageNotes: Use this to inspect the full configuration of a specific ACME plugin instance by its config ID — useful before updating or troubleshooting certificate issuance. Requires Sys.Modify on the root path, so API tokens must carry that privilege. The 'data' field in the response is base64-encoded and contains the DNS provider credentials; decode before inspecting.

examples.summary: Retrieve the configuration of an ACME DNS plugin named 'cf-dns'

tips: The returned 'digest' value can be passed to update/delete operations to guard against concurrent modifications.
If 'disable' is true, the plugin will not be used for certificate renewals even if assigned to a domain.
The 'nodes' field restricts which cluster nodes can use this plugin — empty means all nodes are eligible.
validation-delay defaults to 30 seconds; increase this for DNS providers with long TTLs to avoid premature ACME validation failures.
